Edit: APPLICATIONS CLOSED - We are now reviewing submitted applications and are not accepting any new ones, thank you.

Hermes Health | ONSITE | Venice, CA | Backend Engineer | Full-time | hermeshealth.com

Hermes Health is building a platform to connect identified medical data sources. We are looking for a Rust backend engineer. Our backend is is entirely Rust, via Rocket, and our frontend is (currently) TS via React/Next. However, we are moving the frontend to Rocket via maud+Datastar (similar to HTMX) in order to adopt a "microlith" architecture. Familiarity with event sourcing is recommended, but not required.

This is an in-person position, although we WFH on Fridays and are very flexible on other days as needed. Healthcare and dental available. We are also a startup and have just wrapped up our seed round, we have 2 years of runway and already have paying customers. Happy to discuss more details on this if you'd like.

If you are interested, send an email with your resume to adler@hermeshealth.com
